text:
nina-partnerships: Quick check — KeyMesh + WaveOps (SI) want to rehearse the credential bridge prelaunch. Need to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS key-wrap behavior against Hercules HSM. Can we do a dry-run next Wed? Who from eng/security can join? cc @alex-se @jamie-security

alex-se: I can take the SAML + SCIM flow tests. I’ll need test org IDs and a provisioning user list. Kevin, can you share SP metadata and a staging SCIM endpoint? @kevin-vendor

kevin-vendor: Sharing metadata now: https://files.keymesh.com/metadata.xml
kevin-vendor: Also putting a short playbook in the drive (link in calendar invite). We'll want to exercise SP-initiated SSO + RelayState and check IdP cert rotation handling.

jamie-security: I’ll own the KMS/HSM validation. Requirements: envelope key wrapping must use RSA-OAEP-256 and audit events must include key_id and trace_id for every wrap/unwrap. Note: do NOT use production keys in rehearsal.

nina-partnerships: Proposed plan for Wed 10:00am PT dry-run — quick checklist:
- alex-se: import SP metadata, test single-user SSO
- alex-se: run SCIM create/update/delete tests (sample set ~50 users)
- jamie-security: KMS wrap/unwrap + simulated HSM-backed key rotation
- kevin-vendor: run simulated secrets-import via KeyMesh secret-bridge (no prod secrets)
- nina-partnerships: coordinate embargo window and press readiness

alex-se: For SCIM I’ll push a test CSV + endpoint details. Example curl for a create test:
```
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.keymesh.com/v2/Users -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_TOKEN" -d '{"userName":"test.user1"}'
```

kevin-vendor: Understood. WaveOps SI will also join the call as observers. We can redact emails in payloads if needed.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging IP allowlist required. Add vendor IPs: 52.14.77.200, 34.128.90.45

nina-partnerships: @jamie-security can you confirm rehearsal audit log retention and whether logs will include trace_id we can match to vendor events?

jamie-security: Confirmed — logs include trace_id and key_id. Retention bumped to 72h for this rehearsal window.

kevin-vendor: WaveOps prefers to see SCIM payloads for mapping, but will redact PII. Any objections?

alex-se: Fine to redact; please list which fields you'll mask ahead of time (email, phone, employeeNumber).

nina-partnerships: Locked: Wed 10:00am PT. I’ll send calendar invite with dial-in, runbook link, and a short preflight doc. Last item: joint announcement embargo — target launch date Nov 9, hold until go/no-go after rehearsal.

kevin-vendor: Thanks everyone — we’ll prep staging endpoints and a small demo dataset.`
